name: Guide to Hazardous Taming
description:
A skill book which allows you to tame and ride the following dangerous creatures:
- Slime: Landing deals area damage, absorbing smaller slimes to permanently increase size and jump height. (❤️+ Slimeballs)
- Spider: Climb walls and walk through webs. (❤️+ String)
- Hoglin: Spacebar to swing, knocking up and dealing 3❤️ damage. (❤️+ Crimson Fungus)
- Ravager: Spacebar to roar, dealing 3❤️ damage and 5 blocks knockback in a 5-block radius. (❤️+ Emeralds)
